close_reason: deferred: bodyProperties/bodyValues is a large feature gap requiring significant backend trait changes; filed separately
description: email.rs handle_email_get, handle_email_parse: RFC 8621 §5.1/§5.8 define bodyProperties, fetchTextBodyValues, fetchHTMLBodyValues, fetchAllBodyValues, maxBodyValueBytes as request parameters that control which body values are returned. The handlers parse 'properties' but silently discard these body-fetch parameters without forwarding them to the backend. The MailBackend::get_objects and parse_email trait methods have no way to receive them. Result: clients requesting specific body content via these parameters always get the backend's default, regardless of request.
title: Email/get and Email/parse drop body fetch params
